editorial:
Imagine arriving in a big city with nothing but a sword and a huge dream. That is exactly what happens when D'Artagnan hits Paris. He wants to be a Musketeer, but he quickly finds himself tangled up with three legendary soldiers: Porthos, Aramis, and Athos. You will love the vibe of this movie because it does not take itself too seriously. It is more of a funny take on the classic story than a heavy drama. The friendship between the four guys is the real heart of the film, and their chemistry makes the adventure feel light and breezy.

You will notice that the sword fights are fast and the jokes land well for an older film. While some of the effects look a bit dated, the pacing keeps you moving right along. If you enjoy old-school action and witty banter, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is an older title, you might want to look for a restored 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture. If you are just browsing, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see if you dig the style.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a huge showdown against Cardinal Richelieu and his sneaky plots. D'Artagnan and his three friends manage to outsmart the villains and protect the honor of the Queen. After a series of daring escapes and sword fights, the bad guys are defeated. D'Artagnan finally proves his loyalty and bravery, earning his official spot as a Musketeer. Everything ends on a high note with the four friends standing together as heroes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school sword fights and funny friendships.
